scope: Four frozen pure ingress/ledger files; independent source review and pure compiled tests only.

findings.problem: do_batch permits previously unseen update IDs below the committed watermark. Observed watermark101 plus existing update100 receiving update99 produced a new InboxPending99 with no error.
findings.fix: For update_id below last_committed_offset require exactly one retained valid matching identity; otherwise refuse without insertion or watermark advance. Preserve exact retained duplicates and collision refusal; no pruning/tombstone assumptions.

findings.problem: recover_request sends every status through validate_result. Valid Pending with no chunks becomes HOLD; valid Rejected tombstone with no chunks becomes HOLD with zero message/chat/user and is thereafter invalid as a normal record.
findings.fix: Validate record, then preserve valid InboxPending/InboxRejected with empty chunks. Refuse inconsistent nonempty result on these states. Keep Processing-without-result HOLD and never turn Processing into Pending. Preserve existing HOLD/Completed uncertainty semantics.

findings.problem: Digest covers request_id, bot_id, chat_id and payloads but omits immutable message_id, user_id and text_hash. Independently mutating each of those three fields in a valid ready record leaves validate_result Ok with original chunks/digest.
findings.fix: Bind complete immutable ingress identity in the canonical result digest (or a canonical ingress-identity digest). Version documented schema; update independent reference and mutation controls. Mutable worker/status/timestamps need not become identity.

novel_failure_controls: Rejected empty recovery becomes invalid non-rejected HOLD
message_id mutation accepted with original result
user_id mutation accepted with original result
text_hash mutation accepted with original result

accepted_limits: Ingress required numeric/security fields, allowlist pair, sender_chat and bot refusals, bounded text/payload and truthful command denials passed scoped tests.
Whole chunk-set validation, ordering, digest payload immutability, wrong sender worker/epoch and uncertainty controls work within tested pure transitions.
No source edits, task mutations, database/network/Telegram/runtime effects or production admission.
Durable atomic IO, canonical task/resource fences, trusted transport response correlation and live service testing remain adapter/release obligations.

The original development receipt uses the same descriptive reviewer identity string for another implementing agent; this review was independently delegated to this recovery_review agent, which did not author these four files.
